items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Charlie McCurdy. The interviewer mentions 'Charlie McCurdy' as being in the Georgia Minstrel band, but the interviewee does not confirm a personal connection or interaction with him.

ctx.x: And Charlie lit out Charlie Moore. What were you after him for Bill? I just remember. I just remember.
And that was all the same, didn't I?
